notes.title: WonderLang Update - Japanese Version Improvements!
notes.notes: [p][/p][p]We’ve been hard at work making WonderLang even better for Japanese learners, and we’re excited to share what’s new:[/p][p][/p][h3]1. Voice & Text Improvements[/h3][p]Even though our original voiceovers were created by a native Japanese speaker, some players noticed mispronunciations in certain lines. To make sure everything sounds natural, we brought in a second native freelancer to carefully check [i]every single dialogue line[/i].[/p][p]As a result, we’ve:[/p][list][*][p]Replaced [b]56 dialogue lines[/b] with corrected pronunciation.[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified some early-game text to make it more beginner-friendly.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted pacing in a few places so the audio feels smoother and easier to follow.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]2. New Keyboard Options[/h3][p]Japanese learners use very different input methods depending on their background, so we’ve added new keyboard layouts to make typing easier for everyone:[/p][list][*][p][b]Grouped Kana Keyboard[/b] - For beginners who struggled with the standard JIS layout, this version groups kana by sound, making it easier to find characters.[/p][/*][*][p][b]IME Kana Keyboard[/b] - Type in romaji, and the keyboard automatically converts your input into kana.[/p][/*][*][p][b]IME Kanji Keyboard[/b] (Kanji mode only) - Start with romaji, which converts to kana, and then press the space bar to turn kana into kanji directly.[/p][/*][/list][p]Different players have different play styles, so whether you’re a total beginner or already used to typing in Japanese, WonderLang now adapts to [i]you[/i].[/p][p][/p][h3]3. Bug Fixes[/h3][p]We’ve also squashed a lot of bugs over the past few weeks. If you ever encounter an issue, please let us know at [/p][p][url="https://contact@wonderlang.net"]contact@wonderlang.net[/url][/p][p] most reports are solved within 24 hours.[/p][h3]4. What’s Next[/h3][p]We’re now working on a [b]complete redesign of the UI and menus[/b]. In September, you’ll see:[/p][list][*][p]Cleaner, more responsive menus.[/p][/*][*][p]More customization options for both the game and menu appearance.[/p][/*][*][p]A greatly improved notepad.[/p][/*][*][p]A [b]toggle to switch between base and target language[/b] in all menus.[/p][/*][/list][p]This overhaul also prepares WonderLang for the arrival of new base languages (currently only English). WonderLang is not just for anglophones; expect new base languages [i]before the end of the year[/i]![/p][hr][/hr][p]✨ Thank you for playing and supporting WonderLang. We’re committed to making the game as fun, accessible, and adaptable as possible.[/p]

notes.title: Update August 20th 2025
notes.notes:
- Added 2 keyboard styles for Japanese: IME for Kanjis and a new layout for the standard keyboard where letters are grouped by starting sound.
- Corrected various issues and missing translations accross all languages.

notes.title: Hot Fix July 8th 2025: Italian crash resolved

- Fixed an issue that could block player movement when using mouse navigation to reach an out-of-bounds location.

notes.title: WonderLang Polyglot – July Updates: Korean, Japanese and New Features
notes.notes:
[p][b]WonderLang Polyglot – July Update[/b][/p][p]Hello everyone![/p][p]Here’s what’s new in WonderLang Polyglot:[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]🇯🇵 Japanese Language Update[/b]
The Japanese version is now live! Over the past few weeks, we’ve made key improvements:[/p][list][*][p]A new [b]IME keyboard[/b] lets you type using [b]romaji[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]You can now enable [b]furigana[/b] (small kana above kanji) to support your reading.[/p][/*][/list][p]Coming soon: a [b]Top 150 Kanji Mode[/b]. This new option will focus your learning on words containing the 150 most frequent kanji—perfect for building core reading skills before switching to full-kanji mode.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]🇰🇷 Korean Language Improvements[/b]
The Korean version was added one month ago, and we've just added a new [b]keyboard layout that emulates the standard Korean keyboard[/b], making it easier for learners familiar with physical Hangul input.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]⚔️ Combat Length & Difficulty Settings[/b]
A new [b]combat length setting[/b] lets you adjust how long spaced-repetition battles last by changing enemy HP.
You can now speed things up or slow them down depending on how much time you want to spend drilling.
Combined with the option to [b]reduce or turn off random encounters[/b], you can now fully tailor the pace of your journey.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]🎤 Microphone Test Tool (Windows only)[/b]
Having mic or speech recognition issues? We’ve added a [b]microphone test menu[/b] to help you diagnose and fix them directly in-game.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]🐞 Built-in Bug Report Interface[/b]
You can now report any crash or issue right from the game:[/p][list][*][p]A [b]crash popup[/b] will appear automatically when something goes wrong.[/p][/*][*][p]There’s also a [b]"Report a Bug" button[/b] on the title screen.[/p][/*][/list][p]We commit to fixing all reported issues within [b]24–48 hours[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][p]Thanks again for supporting WonderLang! Your feedback helps us keep improving the experience for language learners worldwide.[/p][p]—The WonderLang Team[/p]

notes.title: Update July 29th 2025
notes.notes:
- Solved some instances of missing or wrong translations for the Spanish Version

- Added a Built-in Bug Report System:
A crash window will appear with the option to send us details.
You’ll also find a “Report a Bug” button on the title screen.
We promise to fix all reported issues within 24 hours (48 hours max).

notes.title: Update July 28th 2025
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a crash with the error message “Uncaught TypeError Crash” when opening certain types of chests.
[*] Added a new option to adjust combat length and difficulty. You can now set a multiplier for enemy HP to increase or reduce the time spent on spaced-repetition-based combats.
[*] Added a microphone test option (Windows only). This new menu allows you to test and troubleshoot microphone issues related to the speech recognition feature.
[*] Slightly improved the accuracy of the speech recognition feature.
[/list]

notes.title: IME Keyboard for Japanese
notes.notes: We have updated the Japanese keyboard with a new format based on IME keyboards. The player can type to romaji letters to get the kana wanted.

notes.title: Bug Fix July 25th 2025
notes.notes: Corrected a bug in the German version that prevented progress when reporting to the engineer about the professor.

notes.title: Save Files issue solved
notes.notes:
Some of you have reported losing save files after the latest update.
If this happened to you, you should see a "Recover Saves" button just below the "Continue" button on the title screen. Clicking it should restore your save files.

If the recovery doesn’t work and you’ve lost progress, please email us at contact@wonderlang.net — we’ll do our best to help resolve the issue and recover your progress.
